verdict.line: Buy. A 3-bed here at about $1,820 to $1,920 psf is at or below what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,010 psf as a new launch). 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this own-stay family area.
reasons: The closest competitors (Blossom Residences, Wandervale, The Rainforest) work out to about $2,010 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 33% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 13 launches).

compsNote: 1 of the 3 competitors are within 1 km. Only executive condos are compared (an EC sells below private condos because of its buyer rules). Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3. Resale ECs past their 5-year minimum occupation period sell to any Singaporean or PR. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 33% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (13 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 3-bed: buy at or below $2,010, walk away above $2,110, this project about $1,871 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,060, walk away above $2,160, this project about $1,850 psf; 5-bed: buy at or below $2,050, walk away above $2,150, this project about $1,834 psf. This project's price by unit type follows how psf changes with size among the competitors (smaller units usually cost more per sq ft).  The developer breaks even at about $1,510 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $1,920 psf.

gain.timeline: Buy at the launch (e-applications targeted from 8 January 2027). Executive condos usually complete about 3.5 years after launch, so TOP around 2030 or 2031. The 5-year minimum occupation period then runs to about 2036, when any Singaporean or PR can buy it (foreigners only after 10 years). We look at a sale in 2036 (9 years). Its tender closed before 8 May 2026, so the 5-year rule applies; later EC sites have a 10-year MOP.
gain.costs: No Seller's Stamp Duty: the sale is after the 5-year minimum occupation period. Potential gain is after Buyer's Stamp Duty at IRAS rates, about $6,000 legal fees and a 2% agent fee plus 9% GST when you sell. Loan interest, property tax, maintenance and rent are not included.

exit.mopNote: HDB 4-room and bigger flats completed from 2021 that reach their 5-year minimum occupation period by about 2036, in the towns resale buyers come from (HDB Property Information, data.gov.sg). New MOP flats add fresh upgraders.
exit.note: At launch an EC bought from the developer is capped by the 30% mortgage servicing ratio (MSR) and a $16,000 household income ceiling; resale buyers after the minimum occupation period face only the 55% TDSR. How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's expected price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
